message.reasoning: The user asks: "洛杉磯和柏林之間的時差是多少？" (What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?). We need to provide the time difference. Los Angeles is in Pacific Time Zone (PT), which is UTC-8 standard, UTC-7 daylight saving. Berlin is Central European Time (CET) UTC+1 standard, UTC+2 daylight saving. So difference is 9 hours during standard time (Los Angeles behind Berlin by 9 hours). During daylight saving, Los Angeles is UTC-7, Berlin UTC+2, difference 9 hours again? Wait: Standard: Los Angeles UTC-8, Berlin UTC+1 => difference 9 hours. Daylight: Los Angeles UTC-7, Berlin UTC+2 => difference 9 hours. Actually both shift by one hour, so difference remains 9 hours. But we need to confirm if daylight saving times align. Los Angeles DST: second Sunday in March to first Sunday in November. Berlin DST: last Sunday in March to last Sunday in October. So there is a period where difference might be 8 or 10? Let's check: In March, Los Angeles DST starts earlier than Berlin. So from March 14 to March 28, Los Angeles is UTC-7, Berlin UTC+1 => difference 8 hours. Then Berlin DST starts on last Sunday of March (March 31?), so after that difference becomes 9 hours again. Similarly in October, Berlin DST ends later than Los Angeles. So from October 29 to November 5, Berlin is UTC+1, Los Angeles UTC-7 => difference 8 hours. After that difference 9 hours again. So typical difference is 9 hours, but there are periods of 8 hours difference. The question likely expects 9 hours. Provide answer accordingly. No function call needed.
